messages:
maya: Heads up — Acme seeing intermittent 503s on /api/v1/generate (eu-west). Anyone know the saved logsearch for org/model/route filters? Need raw request logs + upstream status. @zach @linh

zach: Try this LogSearch query (Saved view: "org-route-quickscan"):
```
org_id:"acme" AND model:/mixtral/ AND route:"/api/v1/generate" AND region:eu-west* AND status:[500 TO 599]
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 500
```
Use the "raw_request" column and include "upstream_code".
Link: https://console.redwood.infra/logs/views/org-route-quickscan

linh: If you want to save a focused view:
1) Run the query above
2) Click "Save view" -> name it `acme-eu-gen-5xx`
3) Set visibility to team:eng-sre
CLI to create saved search (api):
```
POST /api/logs/views
{
  "name": "acme-eu-gen-5xx",
  "query": "org_id:\"acme\" AND model:/mixtral/ AND route:\"/api/v1/generate\" AND region:eu-west* AND status:[500 TO 599]",
  "visibility": "team",
  "tags": ["acme","eu","gen","5xx"]
}
```
Also consider tuning the route-503 alert: current threshold 1% over 5m is noisy during rollouts. Suggest changing to 3% over 5m or add a maintenance window tag.
